Game Engines · 19 Modes
🏆

1v1 / Tournament

Tournament scorer for Six Square / Downball — run it as a round robin ladder or a single-elimination bracket, with live standings and match history.

Play →
⚡

Free For All

Last player standing on a custom court. Build your grid, assign your squares, and battle round by round until one player survives.

Play →
🤝

Team 1v1s

Two teams, one square each. Line up your roster, then rotate through 1v1 duels for points — or a shared pool of lives — until one team comes out on top.

Play →
👥

Team Matchmaking

Pit two rosters against each other — every player gets their own 1v1, matchup by matchup, and whichever team wins the most matches takes it.

Play →
🏁

Checkerboard

Two equal teams alternate squares across a customised checkerboard court. Eliminate opposing players, transfer serve on faults, and resize the court on the fly.

Play →
🔳

Team Squares

Two teams occupy opposing squares with a shared pool of lives. Milestone faults eliminate players until one team remains.

Play →
🏃

Crusade

Sprint along the course, clash in 1v1 handball duels, and breach the enemy base with two consecutive wins to score points before time expires.

Play →
⏱️

Bounce Brigade

Two teams race along a course. Time the run, log finish times, and crown the faster squad.

Play →
📋

Taskmaster

4 to 6 players in pairs race across multi-station minigames. Track routes, time finishes, and crown the winner.

Play →
🏰

Siege

Armies hunt and eliminate hidden Castles in 1v1 duels. Time the race and crown the winner.

Play →
⚔️

Finale 1v1

The final match of Six Square Survivor — the last two standing face off, one life at a time, until a Sole Survivor is crowned.

Play →
🔺

Ultimate FFA

Three modes, one wild rulebook. Play Ultimate Triple, a head-to-head Ultimate 1v1, or design your own numbered court for Ultimate FFA — fewest penalties wins as the rules change round by round.

Play →
👑

King of the Hill

Hold the King's Square to score. Fault and you drop down the ladder. Live leaderboard and a court simulation track every round.

Play →
🗡️

Handball Hitman

Everyone gets a secret target in a hidden loop. Tag, eliminate, and inherit their mark — watch the live target circle shrink until one hitman remains.

Play →
⭕

Encirclement

Take turns in the centre of the cross-court. Strip as many lives from the surrounding encirclees as you can before you're eliminated.

Play →
🛡️

Cornered

One player cornered against a collective pool of surrounding opponents. Strip their shared life pool and shrink their territory before you run out of lives.

Play →
🟢

Game of Bounce

Head-to-head bounce-count scorer. Call your bounces, land the shot, bank the points over as many rounds as you like.

Play →
🚩

Territory Claim

Take turns throwing at targets — claim one and it's yours. Track streaks, watch the live leaderboard, and settle ties with a tiebreaker.

Play →
🥌

Handbowls

Roll or throw as close to the target as you can. Mark the closest ball each round, first to your victory point target takes the game.

Play →

Tiebreaker

Players level on every standings criterion can play off. A 3+ way tie plays a mini round-robin; the results become the final tiebreak criterion. Uses the tournament's match format.
